# spokes-api/types/v1/ref_format.proto



## Types

<a name="github.spokes.types.v1.RefFormat"></a>

### RefFormat
RefFormat encapsulates the possible ref formats for a repository.

| Name | Number | Description |
| ---- | ------ | ----------- |
| REF_FORMAT_INVALID | 0 | REF_FORMAT_INVALID indicates an invalid ref format. |
| REF_FORMAT_FILES | 1 | REF_FORMAT_FILES indicates the files ref format. |
| REF_FORMAT_REFTABLE | 2 | REF_FORMAT_REFTABLE indicates the reftable ref format. |
